acceptanceCriteria: 旧 Runtime の完全な repository-bound archived close receipt は、既存 bytes を変更せず historical compatibility として status entry gate を通過する
current archive with missing, malformed, foreign, or incomplete close evidence remains blocked and fail-closed
current canonical close decisions remain unchanged and non-canonical current decisions cannot be created by the close command
legacy close compatibility does not rewrite predecessor finalization, archive, evidence, or human decision bytes
focused regression tests cover legacy closed archive entry and invalid close rejection
authority: explicit user authorization to expand scope and repair AI Cockpit Runtime compatibility
goal: 旧形式の repository-bound close receipt を限定的な historical compatibility として検証し、現在の malformed または未閉鎖記録を fail-closed のまま保持する
intent: Sentinel の新しい Work Item を開始できない原因となっている、旧 Runtime が生成した閉鎖済み Work Item の互換投影を、immutable evidence を書き換えずに復旧する
outOfScope: Sentinel の業務コード; Decision/Gate/Execution/Position Sizing; Runtime の既存 canonical close vocabulary; immutable archive/evidence/receipt の改変; global Agent/MCP configuration; release packaging
scope: crates/cockpit-repository/src/lib.rs; crates/cockpit-repository/tests/status_projection.rs; 必要なテスト用補助コードのみ
